# `Station`

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_cards.py from catalog/. Do not edit by hand. -->

Result of a Wi-Fi station-mode connection attempt, with the station state on success.

## Summary

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Kind | event (device sends) |
| Grade | PURE GETTER |
| Side-effect tier | B |
| Confidence | READ |
| Basis | static analysis of firmware 9.31, CheckStaConnFunc @0x121710 (only references to the event name), StartCheckStation @0x121ce0 (called only from pi_station_set), PrintStationState @0xb0c80 (64-bit build) |

Broadcast on TCP 4700 (channel I) by the station-check worker after a station connection attempt. The check started by pi_station_set is the only producer: it tests the connection about once a second until the requested timeout. On failure (timeout, an error from the check, or an address in 10.0.0.x) the device deletes the saved network it was trying to join and then sends fail, so a client must re-send credentials to retry and must not assume the network is still saved. A newer pi_station_set stops the previous check without any event for it. On success the event carries state complete and the station object, formatted exactly like the pi_station_state result. On failure it is sent through the state helper (family S): state fail, with code and error only when the supplied code is positive. No timer. Family: S plus custom. APK: recognized by the event-type table (route check disabled for this name) and enters the DeviceService event flow.

Side effects: Observation only.

## Request params

None. Events are sent by the device without a request; the payload is below.

## Payload

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Event` | string | yes | - | Discriminator. Fixed value `"Station"`. [READ] |
| `Timestamp` | string | yes | - | Decimal string with nine fractional digits from a monotonic clock; not a calendar time. [READ] |
| `state` | string | yes | - | complete on success, fail otherwise. One of: `complete`, `fail`. [READ] |
| `station` | object | if state is complete | - | Station connection state, same formatter as pi_station_state. [READ] |
| `station.server` | boolean | yes | - | Always present. [READ] |
| `station.freq` | integer | no | - | Frequency in MHz (unit INFERRED). Only when server is true. [READ] |
| `station.ip` | string | no | - | Station IP address. Only when server is true. [READ] |
| `station.ssid` | string | no | - | Connected network name. Only when server is true. [READ] |
| `station.gateway` | string | no | - | Gateway address. Only when server is true. [READ] |
| `station.netmask` | string | no | - | Netmask. Only when server is true. [READ] |
| `station.sig_lev` | integer | no | - | Received signal level of the associated access point as reported by the wireless driver (iwconfig Signal level), an unscaled integer, normally negative dBm. Only when server is true. [READ (no scaling); unit INFERRED] |
| `station.key_mgmt` | string | no | - | Key-management mode text. Only when server is true. [READ] |
| `code` | integer | if state is fail and the supplied code is greater than 0 | - | Failure code (family S). [READ] |
| `error` | string | if as code | - | Message for code; present together with code. [READ] |

## Errors

None. Failures appear in the payload (`code`, `error`) when `state` is `fail`.

## Example

Event, connected - READ shape, not captured; values invented:

```json
{"Event":"Station","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"complete","station":{"server":true,"freq":2437,"ip":"example-address","ssid":"ExampleNet","gateway":"example-gateway","netmask":"example-netmask","sig_lev":-55,"key_mgmt":"WPA2-PSK"}}
```

Event, failed - READ shape, not captured; no specific failure code is established:

```json
{"Event":"Station","Timestamp":"1234.123456789","state":"fail"}
```
